text:
Little do I know of the night

but the night seems to know of me,

and more still, assists me as if it loved me,

covers my consciousness with its stars.

Perhaps night is life and the sun death.

Perhaps night is nothing

and conjectures about it nothing

and the beings who live it nothing.

Perhaps words are the only thing that exists

in the enormous void of the centuries

that scratch our soul with their memories.

But night must know the misery

that drinks from our blood and from our ideas.

It must throw hatred at our gazes

knowing them full of interests, of missed encounters.

But it happens that I hear the night crying in my bones.

Its immense tear raves

and screams that something went away forever.

Someday we shall be again.

translation.title: The Night
translation.editorial_note: The translation lets night remain both cosmic and intimate, with raves carrying the delirious force of delira.
